research.title: Evidence-Sensitive Abstention in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Investigated whether disagreement among retrieved passages predicts unsupported answers, and led development of an evidence-sensitive abstention mechanism.
Compared passage agreement and answer confidence signals under retrieval perturbations, examining coverage and factual reliability across question categories.

research.title: Negation-Aware Representations for Natural Language Inference
bullets: Formulated a study of negation sensitivity and led development of a contrastive training objective using minimally edited sentence pairs.
Evaluated entailment predictions on lexical and syntactic negation variants, using ablations to distinguish semantic sensitivity from surface cue dependence.

research.title: Boundary Uncertainty in Cross-Domain Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Asked whether uncertain entity boundaries explain cross-domain errors and led development of a boundary-weighted consistency objective for sequence labeling.
Compared token confidence and span agreement under text perturbations, analyzing boundary errors separately from entity type confusion.

research.title: Sentence-Level Evidence Alignment for Factual Summarization
bullets: Formulated a research question linking evidence alignment to summary factuality and led development of an alignment-guided candidate reranking method.
Designed evaluations of sentence support, attribution errors, and evidence omissions, comparing alignment signals with lexical overlap and entailment baselines.

Evidence-Aligned Candidate Reranking for Factual Document Summarization

work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items through established reporting procedures.
Maintained order paperwork, organized supply storage, and coordinated routine replenishment requests with staff responsible for purchasing and receiving.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Text Classification Models
bullets: Implemented sparse linear and pretrained encoder classifiers for topic classification, using consistent data splits and preprocessing for comparative evaluation.
Compared performance across document lengths and class frequencies, inspecting confusion patterns and sensitivity to vocabulary restrictions.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented lexical retrieval and dense passage ranking pipelines, holding the document collection and query splits fixed across comparisons.
Evaluated ranking quality on paraphrased and exact-match queries, analyzing retrieval failures associated with terminology mismatch and ambiguous wording.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches to Keyphrase Extraction
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and neural sequence labeling baselines for keyphrase extraction, applying shared tokenization and span evaluation procedures.
Compared extracted phrases by boundary accuracy and phrase length, examining how decoding constraints affected fragmented and overlapping predictions.
